limitations: National table coverage is source-specific; eight added national tables plus USDA do not establish food composition coverage in all countries.
Recipes are source references pending OffMenu quantities, ingredient identity and cooking review.
Guideline records contain reference metadata only; national document rights are retained and no personal diet rules are inferred.
Wikidata business records are direct type/country assertions, not verified ownership, retail inventory or production-origin evidence.
CNF has one unresolved NutrientID observation retained locally without guessing the mapping.
Japanese parenthesized nutrient quantities remain unresolved; companion special-denominator tables remain complete original files outside the main-food projection.
Remaining registered sources require primary release, access and licence review. Landing-page checks do not mean dataset ingestion.
